أستدل (form X)
# أَسْتَدِلُّ (ʔastadillu) /ʔas.ta.dil.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# أَسْتَدِلَّ (ʔastadilla) /ʔas.ta.dil.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# أَسْتَدِلِّ (ʔastadilli) /ʔas.ta.dil.li/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
